title: Buktu Buktu: the map you draw on foot
description: A map that starts blank and fills in only where you walk for the first time. Car and subway trips are never drawn. Every feature is free.

hero.headline:
A map that only
fills in on foot
hero.lead: It starts as a blank sheet of paper. Only the places you walk fill in, one dot at a time, and walking the same street a hundred times won't widen it. To grow the map, take a new path.
hero.cta: Get it free on the App Store
hero.note: Every feature is free, with no ads.

demo.title: Take a walk
demo.lead: Drag a finger or your mouse across the paper to walk. The blue dots are streets you walked before. Watch how Today's Path changes when you retrace them versus head somewhere new.
demo.hint: Drag across the paper to start walking.
demo.fresh: A new path. The map grows.
demo.same: You've walked this before. Only the distance goes up.
demo.ride: Roads passed by car or subway aren't drawn.
demo.note: Here you drag instead of walking. It uses the app's own rule: anywhere within 30 m of where you've already been counts as the same road. With a keyboard, focus the paper and walk with the arrow keys.

problem.title: Walking the same streets every day?
problem.text: A step counter counts steps but never asks where they went. Home to the station and back fills the ring just fine, so the side street next door stays a mystery for years. Buktu Buktu only counts the paths you walk for the first time, which gives you a reason to go one block out of your way today.

features.title: Stamp the places you've been and want to go
features.text:
Stamp the spot you're standing on, or long-press anywhere on the map. There are 212 stamps to choose from, sorted by category.
A stamp placed where you've never walked stays as a place to visit, then turns into a visited place once you actually get there. Snap a shop sign and the background is cut away, standing up as a sticker for that spot.

features.title: Next walk: the direction you've walked least
features.text:
The Pioneer Compass splits the area around you into eight directions and points to the one you've covered least.
Today's Footprints lines up the places you stopped today in order, with how far you walked between them.

features.title: Every day leaves a shape
features.text:
The calendar draws the shape of each day's walk instead of a number. Keep a daily diary with text and photos, and see how much of each walk was new ground.
Pick a period and watch your map being drawn as a video you can export.

items.title: Open the app

items.title: Head out
items.text: The less familiar the street, the more the map grows.

items.q: I walked, but nothing showed up on the map.
items.a: Go to Settings > Buktu Buktu > Location, choose Always, and turn on Motion & Fitness. That lets it record even when the app is closed. If you picked the battery-saving tracking mode in the app's settings, open the app before you set off. Low-accuracy locations are saved but not drawn.

items.q: Are trips by car or subway recorded?
items.a: No. It uses motion data and speed to draw only walking and running, and leaves out stretches that look like a vehicle. It can occasionally get this wrong.

items.q: I walk the same route every day and the map isn't growing.
items.a: That's the rule. Anywhere within 30 m of where you've already walked counts as the same road, so only first-time paths add to Paths You've Drawn. The sidewalk across the street counts as the same road too. The Pioneer Compass shows where you've walked least.

Not to the developer. Your steps, stamps, diary and photos stay on your device and in your own private iCloud, and the developer can't see them. Anonymous usage statistics never include coordinates, diary text, place names or photos. Apple Maps services are used to turn coordinates into place names. See the Privacy Policy below for details.

items.q: Will my records move to a new device?
items.a: Yes. Sign in with the same Apple Account on the new device and keep iCloud on, and your steps, stamps, diary and photos come with you.

items.q: How do I delete a stamp or a photo?
items.a: Delete stamps from the Places I've Stamped list, and touch and hold a diary photo to delete it. A way to erase all your paths and diary entries at once is on the roadmap.

items.q: How do I add the widget?
items.a: Touch and hold the Home Screen, tap Edit > Add Widget, and choose Buktu Buktu. For the Lock Screen, touch and hold it, then tap Customize. The Home Screen widget shows the shape and length of today's path; the Lock Screen shows today's distance.
An iPhone with iOS 17.0 or later.

items.q: How do I get in touch?
items.a: Send feedback from the app's settings or email us at the address below. We'll reply as soon as we can.
